name: Integrated Positional Encoding (Diagonal Covariance)
definition: Encodes 3D means with sinusoids scaled by powers of two, accounting for Gaussian covariance uncertainty by computing the expected value of the sine/cosine functions under the Gaussian distribution.
summary: Integrated Positional Encoding computes expected sinusoidal values by integrating over Gaussian spatial uncertainty, suppressing high-frequency aliasing unlike standard point-based encodings.
